story: In a multiverse of shattered dimensions, vintage comic book pages flip furiously across the screen in deep crimson light, inked sketches vibrating with cosmic energy. A golden-armored superhero smashes through the two-dimensional paper, sending glowing comic book fragments flying across the widescreen frame. Across a neon-drenched rainy cyberpunk metropolis, an electric-violet speedster races down skyscrapers, trailing holographic lightning, while an arcane mystic conjures spinning golden mandala energy shields in mid-air. Suddenly, the sky fractures as a colossal mechanized cosmic conqueror descends, causing the earth to buckle. The hero team launches into a synchronized mid-air tandem strike in a dramatic bullet-time orbit. Blinding lens flares erupt as a massive metallic 3D emblem slams down onto the screen amidst exploding sparks and smoke, locking into the legendary Marvel-style comic trailer crescendo.
style: Marvel-inspired stylized comic animation, dynamic 3D cel-shaded action, halftone textures, anamorphic lens flares

director_notes.visual_style: High-end 3D cel-shaded comic animation blended with cinematic photorealism, featuring subtle Ben-Day halftone screen print textures, rich ink line-weights, and horizontal streak flares. Dominant color harmony pairs deep comic crimson and radiant metallic gold against electrifying ultraviolet cyan and neon violet. High-contrast dynamic range with pristine ink blacks, lifted specular rim highlights, and intensely saturated heroic energy bursts.
director_notes.camera_style: Controlled cinematic movements prioritizing steady low-angle heroic tracking, slow fluid push-ins, and locked-axis 360-degree bullet-time orbital arcs to prevent AI generation artifacts. Framed on virtual 35mm wide-angle lenses for environmental breadth and 85mm anamorphic primes with shallow depth-of-field and creamy background bokeh. Zero erratic handheld shaking or uncontrolled whipping; all speed is framed through stable parallax and motivated subject motion.
director_notes.lighting: Motivated high-contrast kinetic lighting cast by glowing golden mandalas (3000K warm tungsten glow) and electric-violet lightning arcs (6500K cool ultraviolet), set against deep atmospheric shadows. Volumetric haze filled with suspended comic paper fragments, rain reflections, and glowing energy embers, accentuated by crisp directional edge lighting and sharp horizontal anamorphic flares.
director_notes.editing: Escalating rhythmic pacing structured across 6 concise shots averaging 4 to 5 seconds per scene, strictly locked to the 30-second duration. Hard kinetic cuts on visual impact points and musical transients, utilizing seamless match-on-action framing and flash-frame dimensional transitions.
director_notes.music: 135 BPM driving hybrid cinematic trailer score; Epic-Heroic mood; Powerful brass fanfare, staccato orchestral strings, aggressive sub-bass pulses, and layered modular synth sweeps; Dense multi-layered symphonic texture; Accelerating dynamic build culminating in a thunderous metallic percussion crescendo and deep sub-bass drop.
director_notes.style_lock: Cinematic Marvel-style 3D cel-shaded animation, crimson and ultraviolet cyan palette at 6000K, motivated golden rim lighting with volumetric cosmic dust, halftone paper textures and 35mm anamorphic flares, hyper-detailed heroic rendering.
